description: Find U.S. recalls and notices from FDA (food, medicine, medical device), USDA FSIS (meat, poultry, egg products), CPSC (consumer product) and NHTSA (vehicle) by product, brand, hazard, lot code or UPC. Newest and best matches first. Canadian, UK and EU notices are not searched. An FDA enforcement record gives recall_initiation_date (the recall's start) and report_date (FDA's enforcement report); other records give date. A campaign NHTSA removed from its file carries removed_from_nhtsa_file.

query.description: Words such as "air fryer", "peanut butter salmonella", a lot code or UPC

name: search_recalls
title: Search U.S. recalls
